login.title: Sign in
login.tagline: Shared shopping lists for your flat – synced live, even offline.
login.lead: Your first sign-in creates your account – there’s no separate sign-up.

failed.title: Sign-in didn’t work
failed.body: It was cancelled or failed. Just give it another try.

serverError.title: Signing in isn’t possible right now

sessionExpired.title: You’ve been signed out. Please sign in again.
sessionExpired.body: Your lists and groups are still there.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: Signing in isn’t possible without internet. As soon as you’re back online, you can sign in.

errors.CROSS_ORIGIN_REQUEST: The request was blocked for security reasons.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.GROUP_NAME_INVALID: The group name must be 1 to 30 characters long.
errors.GROUP_NOT_FOUND: This group does not exist, or you are not a member.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.INVITE_EXPIRED: This invite link has expired or was withdrawn.
errors.INVITE_NOT_FOUND: This invite link does not exist.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action is not possible here.
errors.OWNER_IMMUTABLE: The owner cannot leave or change role. Delete the group instead.
errors.TOO_MANY_INVITES: Too many invite links are open already. Withdraw one to create a new one.
